exposure: Swanson's theory of caring in nursing
outcome: childbirth self-efficacy (Self-Efficacy Expectations, Outcome Expectations, CBSEI-C32)
cohort: The study included 130 primiparous women who underwent prenatal check-ups and completed delivery at a single center.
finding: Interventions based on Swanson's care theory effectively improved self-efficacy, reduced pain levels, shortened labor duration, promoted vaginal delivery, and improved maternal and infant outcomes in primiparous women.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate in the Swanson group was significantly lower than in the control group, indicating promotion of vaginal delivery.
